Alger, 31 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Alg: Algiers, August 31, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Algérie Télécom inaugurated a new commercial agency this Sunday, August 30, 2026, in the municipality of Tessala El Merdja, located in the southwestern suburbs of Algiers. This opening is part of the public operator's network expansion in the capital.

Algérie Télécom a annoncé l’ouverture de: Algérie Télécom announced the opening of this new agency via a press release published on its official Facebook page. The location is designed to offer optimized reception and support for customers, proposing the operator's usual services and offers. The company highlights two main objectives: strengthening its local presence and bringing its everyday services closer to users.
L’agence de Tessala El Merdja se présent: The Tessala El Merdja agency is presented as a modern space, where procedures should be simplified and the reception more comfortable. For the municipality's residents, this opening represents an additional contact point, potentially more accessible than the existing agencies in Algiers. Algérie Télécom promises an improved customer experience, without specifying the exact address or opening hours, which are expected to follow the operator's standard agency schedule.
